faq_knowledge.online_btech_validity: 100% Online or Distance B.Tech is strictly INVALID in India under AICTE & Supreme Court norms. Working professionals can only pursue B.Tech Lateral Entry (3 years, after 3-year Polytechnic Diploma) in Regular Flexible-Shift / Weekend mode.
faq_knowledge.sanskriti_non_aicte_explanation: Sanskriti University is NOT separately AICTE approved — it is a UGC Section 2(f) recognized State Private University established under the UP State Act 2016 (NAAC B++). Under Supreme Court precedent (Bharathidasan University v. AICTE), state-act universities have statutory authority to award degrees. If a student specifically needs Direct AICTE approval, Kalinga University (private employees) or Lingaya's Vidyapeeth (Govt/PSU in 75km NCR) is recommended.
faq_knowledge.diploma_to_bca_bba: A 3-Year State Board / AICTE Polytechnic Diploma is officially equivalent to 10+2 (12th pass) for undergraduate admissions. Therefore, a Diploma holder who does not want to pursue B.Tech is 100% eligible for Online BCA, Online BBA, Online B.Com, or Online BA.
faq_knowledge.govt_psu_noc: Government and PSU employees should always check their department's HR policy and obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before enrolling so their degree is smoothly added to their service book for promotion.
faq_knowledge.scam_protection: Through College Vidya, 100% of fees are paid directly on the official university portal/bank account (never to an agent's personal UPI/account) and students receive an official university fee receipt.
